messages:
maya: Weekend micro photo challenge — find something blue near you and post a pic by Sunday 8pm. Camera phone pics totally fine. Bonus points for creative caption :camera_with_flash: :blue_heart:
jack: in! is it ok to edit filters? i'm ✂️ a little extra color sometimes
maya: yes — go wild. the point is fun, not a contest. i'll pick a random coffee voucher winner :coffee: or a silly trophy emoji 🏆
sophia: i'll play! posting from the train commute tomorrow — low-light filter incoming :train2:
leo: here's a preview from my lunch window, not the best but i promise it's blue https://img.example/redwood-lunch-blue.jpg :eyes:
jack: LOVE that sky, leo. fits the theme :+1:
infra-bot: Please keep images safe for work. Files larger than 10MB might not preview in Slack.
maya: quick rule — no GPS metadata in photos please (remove if you're worried).
sophia: caption idea: "accidental ocean" 😂
jack: also — who wants to do next week's theme? i can if no one else volunteers
maya: jack you're on. theme suggestion: "tiny things, big focus" — thanks for joining everyone :heart:
leo: tagging @everyone in case folks miss this thread — join if you want! :bell:
maya: will post reminder on Saturday morning :calendar:
sophia: fun — looking forward to a feel-good thread this weekend :)
